blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) retrieves products matching a reference image modified by natural language---a core capability for eCommerce search. Existing training-free methods fuse CLIP embeddings via arithmetic, but we identify a fundamental limitation: user text modifications are attribute-sparse---a user who types ``make it red with shorter sleeves'' specifies what to change but not what to keep (the floral pattern, the V-neck, the fit-and-flare silhouette). We introduce language-space fusion: a Vision-Language Model (VLM) jointly interprets the reference image and modification to generate a visually grounded product-title caption---e.g., ``Red floral fit-and-flare dress with short sleeves and V-neck''---that fills in the missing attributes from the image. Our method, CaptionFuse, requires no task-specific training and is model-agnostic. A controlled experiment confirms that attribute content--- not linguistic style---drives the gains: imperative and descriptive captions with identical attributes achieve equal R@10, while both outperform raw modifications by +6.5 points.
blocks.zh: 由编成的图像检索(CIR)检索出与由自然语言修改的参考图像相匹配的产品-- eCommerce搜索的核心能力. 现有无训练方法通过算术将 CLIP 嵌入式连接起来,但我们发现了一个根本的局限性:用户文本修改是属性-sparse---一个用户,用更短的袖子来打出"使它红"来指定要改变什么,而不是保留什么(植物图案,V-颈部,适和花纹 silhouette). 我们引入了语言空间聚变:一个视觉语言模型(VLM)联合诠释了参考图像和修改,以生成一个可视化的产品标题标题 -- -- 例如:"红花相配和花相配的外衣有短袖和V-neck'-"来填补图像中缺失的属性. 我们的方法,CaptionFuse,不需要特定任务的培训,并且是模型不可知的. 一个被控制的实验证实了属性内容 - - - 不是语言风格 - - - 驱动收益:具有相同属性的必备和描述性标题实现等同的R@10,而两者的性能都超过了以+6.5分的原始修改.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
A customer browsing an eCommerce catalog sees a blue floral dress and types “make it red with shorter sleeves.”
This is Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) Vo et al. (2019) : retrieving products that match a reference image modified by natural language.
CIR is a high-value capability for product search, yet deploying it at scale is challenging because training-based methods Delmas et al. (2022) ; Gu et al. (2024b) require expensive CIR-specific triplet data that is scarce in most product catalogs.
blocks.zh:
浏览电子商业目录的顾客看到一种蓝色的植物服饰,并用短袖子将它变成红色。 “
这是由Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) Vo et al. (2019): 检索与自然语言修改的参考图像匹配的产品.
CIR是一种高价值的产品搜索能力,但规模化的部署却具有挑战性,因为基于培训的方法Delmas等人(2022年);Gu等人(2024年b年)需要昂贵的CIR专用三重体数据,在大多数产品目录中都是稀缺的.

blocks.en:
Training-free approaches Saito et al. (2023) ; Gu et al. (2024a) ; Tang et al. (2024a) avoid this cost by combining pre-trained CLIP Radford et al. (2021) embeddings, but they operate in embedding space where fine-grained attribute reasoning is lost.
The core problem is that user modifications are attribute-sparse : “make it red with shorter sleeves” specifies what to change but not what to keep —the floral pattern, the V-neck, the fit-and-flare silhouette.
Embedding arithmetic struggles with these sparse modifications for a geometric reason: CLIP’s text encoder was trained on descriptive alt-text, so sparse imperative phrases (“make it red”) map to a generic “modification intent” region of embedding space rather than landing near specific product embeddings.
We show in § 5 that raw modifications achieve only 0.358 mean cosine similarity to their target images, compared to 0.487 for attribute-rich VLM captions—a 36% gap that linear combination cannot bridge when the text vector carries insufficient attribute signal.

核心问题是用户的修改是属性分割 : “ 用较短的袖子让它红”, 指定要改变什么, 而不是保留什么 —— 植物图案, V 颈部, 适和花纹的 silhouette 。
基于几何学原因, CLIP的文本编码器接受了描述性备选文本的培训,因此,必须用很少的短语(“使其为红色”)来绘制一个通用的“修改意图”区域,即嵌入空间而不是落到特定产品嵌入物附近。
我们在§5中显示,原始修改仅实现与它们的目标图像的0.358的同位素相似性,而属性丰富的VLM标题则为0.487——当文本矢量携带不充分的属性信号时,线性组合无法弥合36%的空隙.

blocks.en:
We propose CaptionFuse , which shifts fusion from embedding space to language space .
A VLM jointly interprets the reference image and text modification, then generates a concise product-title caption that fills in the missing attributes—e.g., “Red floral fit-and-flare dress with short sleeves and V-neck.”
The caption is encoded and combined with the reference image embedding for nearest-neighbor retrieval.
The approach is fully training-free and model-agnostic: the VLM, embedding backbone, and vector index are all independently swappable.

标题被编码,并结合了嵌入的参考图像,供最近的邻居检索.

blocks.en: This paper makes four contributions: 1. A visual grounding hypothesis for why language-space fusion outperforms embedding arithmetic: VLM captions enrich queries with concrete visual attributes from the reference image, supported by a controlled experiment showing that attribute content—not linguistic style—drives the gains (§ 5 ). 2. Embedding geometry analysis quantifying why captions produce better queries: 62% larger discriminative margin, with failure modes geometrically identifiable via cosine similarity thresholds and dominated by backbone limitations (68%), not VLM errors (5%). 3. Prompt design as the primary research lever : product-title format yields +5.2 R@10 over verbose captions—larger than any model or weight change—because concise captions avoid reference leakage and carry higher attribute density. 4. Practical deployment framework : model-agnostic design validated across 3 VLMs × \times 3 backbones; rule-based hybrid routing saves 26% of VLM calls with < < 1.1 R@10 loss.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Vision-Language Models such as BLIP-2 Li et al. (2023) , LLaVA Liu et al. (2024a) , and MiniGPT-4 Zhu et al. (2024) bridge frozen image encoders with large language models and have transformed eCommerce applications including product attribute extraction, catalog enrichment, visual question answering, and conversational product search Yang and others (2024) .
Their ability to reason jointly over images and text makes them natural candidates for composed image retrieval—yet no prior work has used VLMs as an intent-aware fusion module that jointly interprets a reference product image and a text modification to produce a single target description.
blocks.zh:
远景语言 BLIP-2 Li等人(2023),LLaVA Liu等人(2024a),MiniGPT-4 Zhu等人等型号. (2024)大桥冷冻影像编码器与大型语言模型,并改造了eCommerce应用,包括产品属性提取,目录丰富,视觉问答,对话产品搜索杨某等人(2024) .
他们能够对图像和文本进行联合推理,使他们成为组成图象检索的自然候选者——以前的工作还没有使用VLM作为意向感聚模块,共同解释参考产品图像和文本修改,以产生单一的目标描述.

blocks.en:
Early approaches to Composed Image Retrieval required task-specific training on (reference image, text modifier, target image) triplets.
ARTEMIS Delmas et al. (2022) learns attention-based composition of image and text features.
CoSMo Lee et al. (2021) modulates content and style features for text-guided retrieval.
CompoDiff Gu et al. (2024b) formulates CIR as conditional diffusion in embedding space.
While effective, these methods depend on expensive triplet annotations that are scarce in most eCommerce catalogs, limiting their applicability to new product domains.
blocks.zh:
早期的编译图像检索方法需要针对任务进行关于(参考图像,文本修改器,目标图像)的三重训练.
阿根廷 Delmas等人(2022年)学习了图像和文字特征的基于关注的构成.
科萨莫 李等编. (2021)为文本制导检索调制内容和样式功能.
CompoDiff Gu等人(2024年b)在嵌入空间中将CIR作为有条件的传播而形成.
虽然这些方法很有效,但它们依赖于昂贵的三重说明,而这些说明在大多数电子商务目录中是稀缺的,限制了其适用于新产品领域。

blocks.en:
To eliminate the annotation bottleneck, recent work explores zero-shot and training-free approaches that leverage pre-trained CLIP Radford et al. (2021) embeddings.
Pic2Word Saito et al. (2023) maps images to pseudo-word tokens in CLIP’s text embedding space.
LinCIR Gu et al. (2024a) learns a linear projection from image embeddings to text-token space, enabling language-only training.
SEARLE Baldrati et al. (2023) optimizes pseudo-tokens via textual inversion at test time.
WeiMoCIR Tang et al. (2024a) introduces weighted modular fusion of CLIP image and text embeddings.
Context-I2W Tang et al. (2024b) maps images to context-dependent words.
KEDs Suo et al. (2024) enhances dual-stream retrieval with external knowledge.
SPRC Liu et al. (2024b) combines sentence-level prompts with region-level captions.
CIReVL Karthik et al. (2024) is the closest to our work: it uses VLMs to generate captions for the reference image, but retrieves via text-only matching—discarding the image embedding entirely.
We include a caption-only ( α = 0 \alpha{=}0 ) ablation in § 4.3 that approximates CIReVL’s approach.

blocks.en:
Recent work leverages Multimodal LLMs beyond captioning.
WISER Cai and others (2024) uses a retrieve–verify–refine pipeline where an MLLM reranks initial retrieval results.
SoFT Bai and others (2024) applies prescriptive/proscriptive reranking via sentence-level prompts.
UniCVR Jiang and others (2024) unifies composed retrieval with MLLM-based reranking.
These post-retrieval verification approaches are complementary to CaptionFuse: they could be stacked on top of our initial retrieval to further improve precision.
We note that their reported CIRCO and CIRR numbers are higher than ours under matched settings, as reranking provides an additional refinement stage that CaptionFuse does not employ.

我们注意到,他们报告的CIRCO和CIRR数字高于我们在匹配的设置下的数字,因为重新排序提供了CaptionFuse没有使用的另一个完善阶段.

blocks.en:
All existing training-free methods operate in embedding space : they combine or project pre-computed vectors without reasoning about which visual attributes to preserve versus modify.
Meanwhile, VLMs have demonstrated powerful conditional reasoning capabilities but remain unused for CIR fusion.
CaptionFuse bridges this gap by shifting fusion from embedding space to language space : a VLM jointly interprets the reference image and text modification, producing a target-describing caption that is then encoded and fused with the image embedding.
Our product-title prompt design draws on chain-of-thought prompting Wei et al. (2022) : by instructing the VLM to be specific about product attributes (color, material, style), we elicit structured outputs that align with how products are indexed in eCommerce catalogs.
blocks.zh:
所有现有的无训练方法都运行在嵌入空间中:它们结合或投射预计算向量,而不推理哪些视觉属性可以保存与修改.
同时,VLMs已经表现出强大的有条件推理能力,但仍没有被CIR核聚变使用.
CaptionFuse通过将聚变从嵌入空间转移到语言空间来弥补这一差距:一个VLM联合解释参考图像和文本修改,产生一个目标描述标题,然后编码并和嵌入图像结合.
我们的产品标题即时设计 借鉴了思维链的即时设计 Wei et al. (2022):通过指示VLM对产品属性(颜色,材料,风格)有具体的规定,我们得出了与产品在eCommerce目录中的索引方式相一致的结构化产出.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 概览

blocks.en:
The query classifier (Step 1) determines whether the text modification carries meaningful semantic content. Text_Image queries contain substantive attribute modifications (e.g., “make it red with shorter sleeves”) and proceed through VLM captioning. Image_Only queries have empty, trivial, or uninformative text (e.g., “find similar”) and bypass the VLM entirely, using image-only retrieval ( α = 1 \alpha{=}1 ).
Classification is rule-based: queries with fewer than 3 content words or matching a stop-phrase list (“similar,” “like this,” “same”) are routed to Image_Only .
This routing is distinct from the hybrid descriptiveness routing (§3.4), which operates within the Text_Image branch to decide whether the VLM caption adds value over direct text encoding.
blocks.zh:
查询分类器(步骤1)确定文本修改是否包含有意义的语义内容. Text_Image 查询包含实质性属性修改(例如“用较短的袖子使其红化”),并通过 VLM 标题进行。 图像_ 只有查询有空的,琐碎的,或非信息化的文本(如“查找相似的”),并完全绕过VLM,使用仅图像检索(α=1\alpha{=}1).
分类以规则为基础:少于3个内容单词的查询或匹配句式列表(“类似,”“像这样,”“相同”)的查询均被引导到Image_ 仅此而已.
这种路由不同于混合描述性路由(§3.4),该路由在Text_Image分支内运行,以决定VLM标题是否比直接文本编码增加了价值.

blocks.en: 3.2 VLM Intent Captioning
blocks.zh: 3.2 VLM 故意说明

blocks.en:
The VLM’s role is to fill in what the user left unsaid.
Given the reference image and text modification, it must decide which visual attributes to preserve (e.g., silhouette), which to modify (e.g., color), and which to infer (e.g., material implied by “shiny”).
This conditional attribute reasoning is impossible in embedding space, where image and text vectors are fixed before fusion.
blocks.zh:
VLM的作用是填写用户未表达的内容.
鉴于参考图像和文字修改,它必须决定哪些视觉属性需要保存(例如,silhouette),哪些是修改(例如,颜色),哪些是推断(例如,“shiny”暗示的材料)。
这种有条件的属性推理在嵌入空间中是不可能的,在那里,图像和文本矢量在聚变之前是固定的.

blocks.en: 3.3 Weighted Embedding Fusion
blocks.zh: 3.3 加权嵌入式融合

blocks.en:
The fused query is: 𝐪 = α ⋅ 𝐞 I + ( 1 − α ) ⋅ 𝐞 c ‖ α ⋅ 𝐞 I + ( 1 − α ) ⋅ 𝐞 c ‖ 2 , α ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \mathbf{q}=\frac{\alpha\cdot\mathbf{e}_{I}+(1-\alpha)\cdot\mathbf{e}_{c}}{\|\alpha\cdot\mathbf{e}_{I}+(1-\alpha)\cdot\mathbf{e}_{c}\|_{2}},\quad\alpha\in[0,1] (1) We find α = 0.15 \alpha=0.15 optimal via grid search on FashionIQ validation (§ 4.3 ): the fusion is heavily text-weighted because a well-crafted caption already encodes the relevant visual attributes.
Note that α \alpha is fixed globally, not adapted per query; we experimented with per-query α \alpha based on descriptiveness score and caption length but found only marginal gains (+0.3–0.6 R@10), insufficient to justify the added complexity.
3.4 Rule-Based Hybrid Routing
blocks.zh: 3.4 基于规则的混合路线

blocks.en:
VLM captioning helps most on vague modifications (“make it more casual”) but can hurt on already-descriptive ones (“is a plain white t-shirt”).
We introduce a lightweight descriptiveness scorer that counts regex matches for concrete visual attributes (color, length, neckline, material, pattern, fit—6 pattern groups) and penalizes vague/relative terms (“more,” “different,” “similar”—2 pattern groups).
The score s ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] s\in[0,1] is computed as s = 0.6 ⋅ concrete_hits 6 + 0.2 ⋅ min ⁡ ( word_count 15 , 1 ) − 0.3 ⋅ vague_hits 2 s=0.6\cdot\frac{\text{concrete\_hits}}{6}+0.2\cdot\min(\frac{\text{word\_count}}{15},1)-0.3\cdot\frac{\text{vague\_hits}}{2} .
Queries scoring above threshold θ = 0.3 \theta{=}0.3 are routed to direct text encoding, saving 26% of VLM API calls while losing only 1.1 points avg R@10.
The full pattern lists and scoring function are provided in the supplementary material.

blocks.en:
The current scorer is manually tuned for fashion attributes; adapting to a new domain (e.g., electronics, furniture) requires updating the 6 concrete-attribute patterns—roughly 2–4 hours of domain expert work per category.
We note that this could be automated: an LLM could generate domain-specific attribute patterns from a product taxonomy, or a lightweight classifier trained on caption-quality labels could replace the rule-based approach.
In our production deployment across 50+ categories, we maintain a shared set of general patterns (color, material, shape) supplemented by category-specific extensions.
blocks.zh:
目前的计分器是手动调制的时尚属性;要适应一个新的域(例如电子、家具),就需要更新6个具体属性模式——每个类别大约2-4小时的域专家工作。
我们注意到,这可以自动化:LLM可以从产品分类中生成特定域的属性模式,或者经过字幕质量标签培训的轻量级分类器可以取代基于规则的方法.
在我们50+类的生产部署中,我们维持一套共同的一般模式(颜色、材料、形状),并辅之以特定类别的扩展。

blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en:
On FashionIQ, CaptionFuse achieves 27.2% avg R@10—within 1 point of WeiMoCIR (28.2%) and ahead of Pic2Word (+2.5) and LinCIR (+0.9).
On CIRCO, the advantage is decisive: CaptionFuse outperforms WeiMoCIR by +8.5 mAP (22.4% vs. 13.9%) and +11.5 R@10 (29.4% vs. 17.9%), demonstrating that language-space fusion excels on complex open-domain queries where VLM reasoning provides a decisive advantage over embedding arithmetic.
On CIRR, CaptionFuse achieves 14.0% R@1 and 63.0% R@10, below WeiMoCIR (26.8% R@1, 68.2% R@10).
CIRR modifications are often short and already attribute-rich (e.g., “show three bottles of soft drink”), where the modification itself nearly describes the target—leaving little for the VLM to fill in and risking noise from hallucinated attributes.
The gap narrows substantially with stronger backbones (Titan: 23.9% R@1); we analyze this dataset-dependent behavior in detail in § 7 .
blocks.zh:
在时装IQ上,CaptionFuse实现27.2%的avg R@10——在WeiMOCIR的1点(28.2%)和Pic2Word(+2.5)和LinCIR(+0.9)之前.
在CIRCO上,优势是决定性的:CaptionFuse以+8.5 mAP(22.4%对13.9%)和+11.5 R@10(29.4%对17.9%)优于WeiMOCIR,表明语言-空间聚变在复杂的开放域查询上优于VLM推理提供决定性优势的嵌入算术.
在CIRR上,CaptionFuse实现14.0% R@1和63.0% R@10,低于WeiMoCIR(26.8% R@1,68.2% R@10).
CIRR的修改往往很短,而且已经具有丰富的属性(例如, " 展示三瓶软饮料 " ),修改本身几乎描述了目标——为VLM填充和冒着来自幻觉属性的噪音而留下的微量。
用更强大的骨干(泰坦语:23.9% R@1)来缩小差距;我们在§7中详细分析这种依赖数据集的行为.

blocks.en:
Caption-only vs. full fusion. The caption-only row ( α = 0 \alpha{=}0 ) approximates CIReVL’s Karthik et al. (2024) text-only retrieval approach.
It outperforms raw-text encoding (23.3 vs. 22.2 avg R@10), confirming that VLM captions are better query representations.
However, adding even a small image component ( α = 0.15 \alpha{=}0.15 ) yields a further +1.5 R@10, showing the image provides complementary signal—e.g., exact fabric texture or silhouette details that the caption omits.
We acknowledge that at α = 0.15 \alpha{=}0.15 , the system is predominantly text retrieval with a small image correction.
We view this as validating the visual grounding hypothesis: a well-crafted VLM caption captures nearly all the discriminative information needed for retrieval, because it explicitly describes both changed and preserved attributes.
The 1.5-point image contribution is small but consistent across all categories, and represents exactly those cases where the caption underspecifies—e.g., exact fabric drape or background context.
For applications where encoding cost is critical, caption-only retrieval ( α = 0 \alpha{=}0 ) is a viable operating point with minimal quality loss.

仅说明与全聚变. 仅标题行( α = 0\ alpha{=}0) 大致为 CIREVL 的 Karthik et al. (2024) 仅文本检索方法 。
它的性能超过了原始文本编码(23.3 vs 22.2 avg R@10),确认VLM标题是更好的查询表示.
然而,即使添加一个小的图像组件(α = 0.15\alpha{=}0.15),也会产生一个进一步的+1.5 R@10,显示图像提供了互补信号——例如,准确的织物纹理或线条细节,字幕省略了这些细节.
我们承认,在α = 0.15\alpha = 0.15时,系统主要是文本检索,并有小的图像修正。
我们认为这证实了视觉地面假设:一个精心设计的VLM字幕捕捉了检索所需的几乎所有歧视性信息,因为它明确描述了改变和保存的属性。

对于编码成本至关重要的应用程序,只有标题检索(α = 0\alpha{=}0)是一个可行的操作点,质量损失最小.

Prompt design. The product-title format yields +5.2 avg R@10 over verbose captions—the single largest lever.
Table 3 illustrates the difference.
The v1 prompt produced 25–35 word captions with reference leakage (“instead of the blue and white patterned…”), which dilutes the target signal with irrelevant reference attributes.
The v2 product-title prompt produces 8–15 word captions with zero leakage and higher attribute density.

blocks.en: 5 Why Language-Space Fusion Works
blocks.zh: 5 为什么语言空间融合工程

blocks.en:
The pipeline of CaptionFuse is deliberately simple—the research contribution lies in understanding why it works and when it fails.
We provide three complementary analyses using CLIP’s internal representations.
blocks.zh:
CaptionFuse的管道刻意简单——研究贡献在于理解它为什么运作和失败时.
我们利用国际法律援助中心的内部陈述提供了三项补充分析。

blocks.en:
CLIP’s text encoder was trained on ∼ \sim 400M image-alt-text pairs Radford et al. (2021) , where the text is predominantly descriptive (e.g., “red floral midi dress with short sleeves”).
User text modifications in CIR are typically imperative and attribute-sparse (e.g., “make it red with shorter sleeves”—specifying only the changes, not the full target).
The geometric consequence is that sparse imperative phrases occupy a different region of CLIP’s embedding space than the descriptive product titles that populate the retrieval gallery.
When embedding arithmetic combines the reference image vector with a sparse modification vector, the result inherits the modification’s generic “change intent” direction rather than landing near a specific target product.
The arithmetic assumes that attribute edits correspond to linear directions in the joint space—an assumption that breaks down when the text vector carries only 2–3 attributes while the target requires 6–8 to discriminate among visually similar products.
blocks.zh:
CLIP的文本编码器接受了\\sim 400M图像-备选案文-文本对Radford等人(2021年)的培训,其中文本主要是描述性的(例如, " 红花米蒂裙带有短袖 " )。
CIR中的用户文本修改通常是必须的和属性分割的(例如, " 用较短的袖子使其红 " ——只指明更改,而不是全部目标)。
几何学的后果是,与充斥检索通道的描述性产品标题相比,CLIP嵌入空间中少见的必用词占据了不同的区域。
当嵌入算术将参考图像向量与稀疏的修改向量结合时,结果继承了修改的通用"改变意图"方向,而不是降落在某个特定目标产品附近.
算术假设属性编辑与联合空间中的线性方向相对应——当文本矢量仅包含2–3属性而目标要求6–8对视觉相似产品进行区分时,这个假设会分解.

blocks.en:
We quantify this misalignment by measuring mean cosine similarity between text embeddings and their paired target image embeddings across 200 FashionIQ dress queries.
Raw text modifications (which specify only the changes) achieve mean text-target similarity of 0.358; VLM captions (which describe the full target) achieve 0.487—a 36% improvement in alignment.
This gap is too large for linear combination to bridge: even at optimal α \alpha , the fused vector α ⋅ 𝐞 I + ( 1 − α ) ⋅ 𝐞 t \alpha\cdot\mathbf{e}_{I}+(1{-}\alpha)\cdot\mathbf{e}_{t} cannot reach embeddings that the raw text 𝐞 t \mathbf{e}_{t} never pointed toward.
The VLM addresses this by producing text that is both attribute-rich (covering preserved attributes from the image) and distributionally aligned with gallery product titles—though our controlled experiment below shows the former is the dominant mechanism.
blocks.zh:
我们通过测量文本嵌入及其配对的目标图像嵌入在200个时尚IQ服装查询中的平均余弦相似度来量化这种错配.
原始文本修改(仅具体说明修改)实现平均文本目标相似度0.358; VLM 标题(描述全部目标) 实现 0.487-a 36% 的对齐性改进.
此缺口太大, 线性组合无法连接 : 即使在最佳的 α\ alpha 中, 被保险的矢量 α\ e I + (1− α) → e t\ alpha\ cdot\ mathbf{ e} (1{- }\alpha)\ cdot\ mathb{ e}_{t ) 无法达到原始文本 e t\ mathbf{ e}_{t} 从未指向过的嵌入 。
VLM通过制作既富于属性的文本(覆盖图像中保存的属性),又在分配上与画廊产品标题保持一致来解决这个问题,尽管我们下面的控制实验表明前者是主导机制。

blocks.en:
To disentangle linguistic style (imperative vs. descriptive) from attribute content (sparse vs. grounded), we conduct a controlled experiment.
For 200 dress queries, we take the VLM-generated caption and create an imperative variant with identical attributes: e.g., “Red floral fit-and-flare midi dress” → \rightarrow “Make it a red floral fit-and-flare midi dress.”
The results are striking: the descriptive and imperative variants achieve identical R@10 (23.0%), while both outperform the raw modification by +6.5 R@10 (16.5%).
blocks.zh:
要将语言风格(imperative vs. description)与属性内容(sparse vs. bound)区分开来,我们进行一个有控制的实验.
对于200件着装问题,我们采用VLM生成的字幕,并创建一个具有相同属性的必备变体:例如“红色花朵合身和Flare midi dress” ~\右旋“使其为红色花朵合身和Flare midi dress 。 “
结果是惊人的:描述性变体和必须变体实现相同的R@10(23.0%),而两者的性能都超过了原始修改+6.5R@10(16.5%)。

blocks.en:
The contribution of this experiment is establishing a lower bound on the mechanism : the entirety of the +6.5 R@10 gain is attributable to attribute enrichment (going from 2–3 attributes in the raw modification to 6–8 in the caption), not to distributional properties of the caption text.
This rules out the alternative hypothesis that CaptionFuse works merely because product-title-format text is closer to CLIP’s training distribution—if distributional match mattered, the descriptive variant should outperform the imperative one.
The practical implication is clear: what matters is how many attributes the query specifies, not how they are phrased.
This also explains why verbose v1 captions (25–35 words) perform worse than concise v2 captions (8–15 words) despite being more descriptive: v1 captions leak reference attributes (“instead of the blue patterned…”), which dilutes the target signal with irrelevant content—reducing effective attribute density even as total word count increases.
blocks.zh:
这一试验的贡献是在机制上建立较低的约束:+6.5 R@10 收益的全部归属于属性增益(从原始修改中的2-3属性到标题中的6-8属性),而不是标题文本的分布属性.
这排除了另一种假设,即CaptionFuse只因为产品标题格式文本更接近CLIP的培训分配----如果分配匹配重要的话,描述性变体应比必须的要好。
其实际含义是明确的:重要的是,查询所指明的属性有多少,而不是其措辞如何。
这也解释了为什么动词v1标题(25–35字)的性能比简洁的v2标题(8–15字)要差,尽管描述性更强:v1标题漏出参考属性(“而不是蓝色的图案......”),它用不相关的内容稀释了目标信号——即使总字数增加,也降低了有效的属性密度.

blocks.en:
Figure 5 compares cosine similarity between fused query embeddings and ground-truth targets for 200 dress queries.
Caption-based queries achieve mean target similarity of 0.378 vs. 0.356 for raw-text queries.
The discriminative margin (target similarity minus nearest-neighbor similarity) increases by 62% : from 0.043 to 0.070.
Caption queries are closer to the target in 76% of cases.
Importantly, the image embedding contributes even at α = 0.15 \alpha{=}0.15 : removing it entirely ( α = 0 \alpha{=}0 ) drops R@10 by 1.8 points, confirming that the image provides complementary visual signal that the caption does not fully capture (e.g., exact fabric texture, background context).
blocks.zh:
图5比较了引信查询嵌入与200次服装查询的地面真实目标之间的余弦相似性。
基于说明的查询实现原始文本查询的0.378对0.356的平均目标相似。
差别比值(目标相似度减去近邻相似度)增加62%:从0.043增至0.070.
在76%的案件中,说明查询更接近目标。
重要的是,图像嵌入甚至在α = 0.15\alpha{=}0.15 :完全删除(α = 0\alpha{=}0)时会将R@10降为1.8分,证实图像提供了互补的视觉信号,说明标题不能完全捕捉到(如准确的布料纹理,背景背景).

blocks.zh: 图5:嵌入几何. 左边: 标题查询具有更高的目标相似性 。 右:62%的差别幅度。

blocks.en:
Of 500 dress queries, we categorize failures (ground-truth rank > > 50) into four types based on the relationship between caption quality and retrieval outcome (Figure 6 ).
We use cosine-similarity thresholds derived from the observed bimodal distribution of caption-target similarities: the distribution exhibits a clear valley between 0.30–0.35, with a low-similarity mode (mean ∼ \sim 0.25, corresponding to captions that introduce incorrect attributes) and a high-similarity mode (mean ∼ \sim 0.38, corresponding to semantically reasonable captions that the encoder fails to discriminate).
We set thresholds at these natural boundaries: embedding limitation (68%, mean target sim 0.366)—the caption is semantically reasonable (caption-target sim > > 0.35) but CLIP cannot distinguish fine-grained attributes (e.g., “ruched” vs. “pleated”); VLM hallucination (5%, sim 0.338)—the caption-target similarity is low ( < < 0.30), indicating the caption introduces spurious attributes not present in either the reference or the modification; already descriptive (6%, sim 0.378)—the raw text modification already achieves higher target similarity than the caption, and VLM captioning adds noise; success (21%, sim 0.414)—ground-truth rank ≤ \leq 50.
We acknowledge these thresholds are approximate cluster boundaries, not precisely calibrated cutoffs; qualitative inspection of 20 randomly sampled “embedding limitation” cases confirmed that 18/20 had captions correctly describing the target while the retrieved items were visually similar distractors differing in fine-grained attributes (e.g., sleeve length, neckline shape).
The dominance of embedding limitations (68%) over VLM errors (5%) has a direct practical implication: CaptionFuse has already extracted near-maximum value from the VLM—further gains require better embedding backbones.
This prediction is confirmed by the +8.5 R@10 gain from upgrading CLIP to Titan with zero pipeline changes.
blocks.zh:
在500次着装查询中,我们把失败归为一类(地面-真相排名 > 根据标题质量与检索结果之间的关系,分为四类(图6)。
我们使用从所观察到的双模式分布标题-目标相似度中得出的同位素-同位素阈值:分布显示在0.30-0.35之间的一个清晰的河谷,低同位素模式(与引入不正确属性的标题相对应的平均值\sim 0.25)和高同位素模式(与编码器没有歧视的高度合理的标题相对应的平均值\sim 0.38)。
我们对这些自然边界设定了阈值:嵌入限制(68%,平均目标为0.366)——标题非常合理(上限-目标为 > > 0.35),但CLIP无法区分细微的属性(例如,“ruged”对“fulated”); VLM幻觉(5%,sim 0.38)-标题-目标相似度较低( < 0.30),说明标题引入了参考或修改中没有的虚假属性; 已经说明性(6%,sim 0.378)-原始文本修改已经实现了比标题更高的目标相似性, VLM字幕增加了噪音; 成功(21%,sim 0.414)-地面-真相排名 \\leq 50。
我们承认这些阈值是大致的集群界限,并非精确地校准了截断点;对20个随机抽样的“嵌入限制”案例的定性检查证实,18/20有正确描述目标的标题,而取回的物品是视觉上相似的转移器,在细纹属性(例如袖子长度、颈线形状)上有所不同。
嵌入限制(68%)相对于VLM错误(5%)具有直接的实际影响: CaptionFuse已经从VLM-进一步收益中提取了近最大值,需要更好的嵌入骨干。
这一预测得到+8.5 R@10因CLIP升级为Titan而无管道变化而得到的收益的证实.

blocks.zh: 图6:故障模式几何. 每种类型的区域都具有明显的相似性。 嵌入限制占主导地位。

blocks.en: 6 Lessons for Production eCommerce Search
blocks.zh: 6 生产电子商务搜索的经验教训

blocks.en:
Switching from verbose to product-title prompts (+5.2 R@10) had more impact than switching VLM backends (+2.7 R@10) or tuning fusion weights (+1.8 R@10).
For practitioners: invest in prompt engineering before exploring model alternatives.
blocks.zh:
从动词切换到产品标题提示(+5.2 R@10)的影响大于切换VLM后端(+2.7 R@10)或调谐聚变重量(+1.8 R@10).
对从业者:在探索模型替代品之前,先投资于即时工程.

blocks.en:
Table 5 shows hybrid routing results on the full FashionIQ val set using Nova Pro VLM.
Note: these numbers differ from the main table (which uses 200 queries/category with Claude Sonnet) due to different VLM backends and query subsets.
At θ = 0.3 \theta{=}0.3 , 26% of queries bypass the VLM entirely, reducing API cost proportionally while losing only 1.1 points R@10.
Queries with concrete attributes (“red cotton v-neck dress”) need no VLM reasoning.
Interestingly, on toptee, hybrid routing at θ = 0.3 \theta{=}0.3 slightly outperforms always-VLM (25.0 vs. 24.8), suggesting VLM captioning can hurt on already-descriptive queries—consistent with our “already descriptive” failure mode.

带有具体属性的查询(“红棉v-颈部服装”)不需要VLM推理。
有趣的是,在Toptee上,混合路由在 θ = 0.3\theta{=}0.3 时,表现总是略高于VLM(25.0 vs 24.8),表明VLM的字幕会伤害到已经描述的询问——符合我们的“已经描述的”故障模式。

blocks.en:
Our failure analysis shows 68% of failures are embedding limitations—the VLM produces a good caption, but the encoder cannot distinguish the fine-grained attributes it describes.
Upgrading from CLIP to Titan gave +8.5 R@10—the largest single improvement—because a better encoder can act on the richer attribute signal that CaptionFuse’s captions provide.
blocks.zh:
我们的失败分析显示, 68%的失败正在嵌入限制 —— VLM 产生了很好的标题, 但编码器无法区分它描述的精细属性 。
从CLIP升级到Titan给出了+8.5 R@10,这是最大的单一改进,因为更好的编码器可以在CaptionFuse 标题提供的更丰富的属性信号上发挥作用.

blocks.en:
CaptionFuse requires no retraining when upgrading any component.
Pic2Word Saito et al. (2023) injects pseudo-word tokens into CLIP’s tokenizer; LinCIR Gu et al. (2024a) learns a projection matched to CLIP’s geometry; WeiMoCIR Tang et al. (2024a) tunes weights for CLIP’s vector space.
All three are architecturally tied to CLIP: swapping the backbone requires retraining.
In contrast, CaptionFuse’s VLM caption is plain text consumable by any multimodal encoder.
We verified this by swapping 3 VLMs and 3 backbones with zero code changes—9 configurations, all functional.
A team can start with CLIP + Nova Pro, then swap to Titan when available, without touching the pipeline.
blocks.zh:
CaptionFuse 升级任何组件时不需要再培训.
Pic2Word Saito等人(2023年)在CLIP的标致器中注入伪字符号;LinCIR Gu等人(2024年a年)学习了与CLIP几何相匹配的投影;WeiMoCIR Tang等人(2024年a年)为CLIP的矢量空间调子.
三者在建筑上都与CLIP联系在一起:交换骨干需要再培训.
相比之下,CaptionFuse的VLM标题是任何多式联运编码器所消耗的纯文本。
我们通过交换3个VLM和3个主干,零代码更改——9配置,所有功能,来验证这一点.
一个团队可以从 CLIP + Nova 开始 Pro,然后在有空的时候交换给泰坦,而不碰管道.

blocks.en:
Embedding-space methods encode the raw text modification—e.g., “make it red with shorter sleeves” (7 words, no visual grounding, imperative form).
CaptionFuse generates a VLM caption—e.g., “Red floral fit-and-flare midi dress with short sleeves” (10 words, visually grounded, descriptive form)—that carries substantially more retrievable signal.
As embedding models improve their ability to discriminate fine-grained attributes, CaptionFuse benefits disproportionately because the caption’s information content is higher.
Concretely, CLIP → \rightarrow Titan gave CaptionFuse +8.5 R@10 on FashionIQ and +9.3 mAP on CIRCO (22.4 → \rightarrow 31.7).
We predict embedding-space methods would gain less from the same upgrade because their text input remains information-poor—a prediction we plan to verify by running WeiMoCIR on Titan in future work.
We also note that MLLM-based reranking approaches (WISER Cai and others (2024) , SoFT Bai and others (2024) ) are complementary: CaptionFuse could serve as the first-stage retriever, with MLLM verification applied to the top- k k results for further precision gains.
We did not test CaptionFuse + MLLM reranking in this work due to API cost constraints (reranking requires ∼ \sim 10 additional VLM calls per query), but the approaches are architecturally orthogonal: CaptionFuse improves first-stage recall (the quality of candidates retrieved), while reranking improves precision within that candidate set.
We expect the combination to outperform either approach alone and plan this experiment for future work.
blocks.zh:
嵌入-空间方法将原始文本修改编码——例如, " 用较短的袖子使它变红 " (7个字,没有视觉地面,必须形式)。
CaptionFuse 生成一个 VLM 标题—— 例如 , " 红花装和短袖短袖裙 " (10个字、视网膜、描述形式) -- -- 带有可检索得多的信号。
CaptionFuse在嵌入模型中提高了区分精细属性的能力,
具体来说,CLIP →\右手巨人在时装IQ上给出CaptionFuse+8.5 R@10,在CIRCO上给出+9.3 mAP(22.4 →\右手巨人 31.7).
我们预测嵌入空间方法将从同样的升级中获得较少的收益,因为它们的文本输入仍然信息贫乏——我们计划在今后的工作中通过运行泰坦上的WeiMoCIR来验证这一预测.
我们还注意到,基于MLLM的重新排序方法(WISER Cai等人(2024年)、SoFT Bai等人(2024年))是相辅相成的:CaptionFuse可作为第一级检索器,MLLM的核查适用于最高-kK成果,以便进一步获得精确收益。
由于API成本限制,我们没有测试CaptionFuse + MLLM 在这项工作中重新排位(重新排位要求 \\sim 10 附加 VLM 调用每个查询),但是这些方法在建筑上是正统的:CaptionFuse 改善了第一阶段召回(检索到的候选人的质量),同时重新排位提高了该候选人集的精度.
我们期望这种组合能够超越单独的办法,并为今后的工作规划这一试验。

blocks.en: 7 Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 限制

blocks.en:
CaptionFuse + CLIP underperforms WeiMoCIR on CIRR (14.0 vs. 26.8 R@1).
CIRR’s text modifications are often short and already attribute-rich (e.g., “show three bottles of soft drink,” “the dog is a golden retriever”), leaving little for the VLM to fill in.
In these cases, the raw modification already functions as a near-complete target description, and VLM captioning can introduce noise by hallucinating unmentioned attributes from the reference image.
This is most pronounced for short, precise queries ( ≤ \leq 5 words) that already name the target object—where any VLM-added attributes (inferred from the reference) risk pulling the query away from the intended target.
For longer CIRR queries ( > > 12 words) that describe complex scene changes, the gap narrows as the VLM’s attribute-reasoning ability becomes more relevant.
The Titan backbone substantially closes this gap (23.9 R@1), suggesting the issue is partly CLIP-specific: Titan’s stronger fine-grained discrimination can better exploit the VLM caption even when the modification is already descriptive.
We also note that we do not report CIRR’s Recall Subset {}_{\text{Subset}} @K metric (retrieval within the 6-image candidate set), which would provide additional insight into image-dependence; we plan to add this in a revision.
blocks.zh:
CriptionFuse + CLIP在CIRR上表现不佳(14.0对26.8 R@1).
CIRR的文字修改往往很短,而且已经具有丰富的属性(例如, " 展示三瓶软饮料 " , " 狗是金色的检索器 " ),留给VLM填写的则很少。
在这些情况下,原始修改已经作为近乎完整的目标描述发挥作用,而VLM字幕可以通过从参考图像中幻灭未提及属性来引入噪音.
对于已经命名目标对象的短而精确的询问(\\\leq 5 words)来说,这一点最为明显——其中任何VLM加成属性(从参考文献中推断)都有可能使询问脱离预定目标.
对于描述复杂场景变化的较长的CIRR查询( > 12个字),随着VLM的属性推理能力变得更加相关,差距缩小.
土卫六的主干线大大缩小了这一差距(23.9 R@1),说明这个问题部分是CLIP特有的: Titan更强烈的精细歧视,
我们也注意到,我们不报告CIRR的“召回子集 { text{Subset{@K rim”(在6-图像候选集内检索),这将对图像依赖性提供更多的见解;我们计划在修订中添加这一点。

blocks.en:
Recent MLLM-augmented methods (WISER Cai and others (2024) , SoFT Bai and others (2024) ) report higher numbers on CIRCO and CIRR than CaptionFuse under matched settings.
These methods employ post-retrieval MLLM reranking, which is complementary to our first-stage retrieval.
We also do not compare against baselines using larger backbones (e.g., ViT-G/14), which would likely improve all methods, nor against domain-specific encoders (FashionCLIP, Marqo-FashionSigLIP) that address the encoder bottleneck from the complementary direction of domain-specialized training.
Since CaptionFuse is encoder-agnostic, such encoders are drop-in replacements that could yield further gains on FashionIQ specifically—a hypothesis directly testable given our architecture.
A comprehensive comparison across backbone scales and domain specializations is needed to fully assess CaptionFuse’s relative positioning.
blocks.zh:
最近的MLLM强化方法(WISER Cai等人(2024年)、SoFT Bai等人(2024年))报告CIRCO和CIRR的数字高于CaptionFuse在匹配设置下的数字。
这些方法采用了检索后MLLM重排,是对第一阶段检索的补充.
我们还不与使用更大的主干线的基线(如ViT-G/14)进行比较,后者可能改进所有方法,也不与专门域编码器(时装CLIP,Marqo-FashionSigLIP)进行比较,后者从域专门培训的补充方向解决编码瓶颈问题。
由于CaptionFuse是编码器-不可知论的,这种编码器是滴入式替换器,可以特别在FashionIQ上产生进一步的收益——根据我们的架构,这个假设可以直接测试.
为了全面评估CaptionFuse的相对位置,需要对主干规模和域专门化进行全面比较。

blocks.en:
Our strongest results use proprietary APIs (Amazon Titan, Nova Pro), limiting exact reproducibility.
However, we validate the core mechanism with fully open components (CLIP + Llama 4 Maverick), achieving 24.0% avg R@10 on FashionIQ—above the No Caption baseline (22.2%).
The visual grounding mechanism (§ 5 ) is architecture-independent and applies to any encoder.
We will release code, prompts, and routing rules to enable reproduction with open models.
blocks.zh:
我们最强的结果使用专有的API(Amazon Titan, Nova Pro),限制了准确的再生产.
然而,我们用完全开放的组件(CLIP + Llama 4 Maverick)验证核心机制,在FashionI上实现24.0%avg R@10,高于无标题基线(22.2%)。
视觉定位机制(§5)是架构独立的,适用于任何编码器.
我们将发布代码、提示和路由规则,以允许使用开放式模型复制。

blocks.en:
CIRCO’s validation set contains only 220 queries; mAP differences on this set should be interpreted with caution.
FashionIQ (6,016 queries) and CIRR (4,181 queries) provide more statistically robust comparisons.
blocks.zh:
CIRCO的验证集只包含220个查询;对mAP关于这个集的差异应谨慎解释.
时尚IQ(6,016个查询)和CIRR(4,181个查询)提供了统计上更强的比较.

blocks.en:
VLM captioning adds 449–1,169ms per query.
While caption caching and hybrid routing mitigate this, real-time applications with strict latency budgets ( < < 100ms) would require model distillation or pre-computation strategies not explored here.
blocks.zh:
VLM 字幕每个查询增加449–1,169ms.
虽然字幕缓存和混合路由减轻了这种情况,但具有严格缓存预算( < 100ms)的实时应用程序将需要在此没有探讨的模型蒸馏或预计算战略。

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en:
We presented CaptionFuse, a training-free composed product retrieval system that performs fusion in language space via VLM intent captioning.
Our central finding is that CaptionFuse’s effectiveness stems from visual grounding : VLM captions enrich attribute-sparse modifications with concrete visual attributes from the reference image.
A controlled experiment confirms that attribute content—not linguistic style—drives the gains.
This explains why prompt format (+5.2 R@10) matters more than model choice (+2.7 R@10), why verbose captions hurt despite being longer (reference leakage dilutes the target signal), and why better backbones yield outsized gains (+8.5 R@10 on FashionIQ, +9.3 mAP on CIRCO).
Embedding geometry analysis confirms that 68% of remaining failures are backbone limitations, not VLM errors—positioning CaptionFuse to benefit directly from future encoder improvements.
blocks.zh:
我们介绍了CaptionFuse,这是一个无培训产品检索系统,通过VLM意图标题在语言空间进行聚变。
我们的核心发现是CaptionFuse的效能来自于视觉地面: VLM 标题用参考图像中的具体视觉属性来丰富属性分隔的修改.
一个有控制的实验证实,属性内容——而不是语言风格——驱动收益。
这解释了为什么快速格式(+5.2 R@10)比模型选择(+2.7 R@10)更重要,为什么动词标题尽管较长(参考渗漏会淡化目标信号),为什么更好的主干线产生超大收益(FashionIQ上的+8.5 R@10,CIRCO上的+9.3 mAP).
嵌入几何分析证实,68%的剩余故障是骨干限制,而不是VLM错误——将CaptionFuse定位,直接从未来的编码器改进中受益.

blocks.en:
Beyond the academic benchmarks reported above, we have deployed CaptionFuse with the Titan backbone on a production eCommerce platform serving 2M+ products across 50+ categories.
With hybrid routing ( θ = 0.3 \theta{=}0.3 ) and caption caching, the system achieves sub-second query latency at the p95 level.
The caption cache achieves approximately 40% hit rate on repeated or near-duplicate queries, effectively eliminating VLM latency for returning users.
The system has been serving live traffic for over 8 weeks without quality degradation, processing thousands of CIR queries daily.
Full A/B testing against the previous text-only search baseline with user engagement metrics (click-through rate, add-to-cart) is in progress and will be reported in future work.
blocks.zh:
除了上述学术基准外,我们还在生产电子商务平台上安装了CaptionFuse(CaptionFuse)和Titan主干网,服务于50多个类别中的2M+产品。
通过混合路由(  = 0.3\theta{=}0.3)和标题缓存,系统在p95级别实现次秒查询空闲.
字幕缓存在重复或接近重复的查询中实现约40%的命中率,有效消除了返回用户的VLM延迟.
该系统连续8周没有出现质量下降,每天处理成千上万的CIR查询。
正在对照先前的仅文本搜索基线进行完全的A/B测试,使用用户参与指标(点击率、加载卡),并将在今后的工作中报告。

blocks.en:
Our immediate priorities are threefold.
First, stacking MLLM reranking (WISER/SoFT) on top of CaptionFuse retrieval to test complementarity—if our enriched first-stage retrieval reduces the reranker’s error rate, the combination could outperform either alone at lower total VLM cost.
Second, running embedding-space baselines (WeiMoCIR, LinCIR) on the Titan backbone to verify our scaling prediction that these methods gain less from better encoders because their text inputs remain attribute-sparse.
Third, reporting CIRR Recall Subset {}_{\text{Subset}} @K and stratifying CIRR results by query characteristics (word count, attribute density) to precisely characterize where VLM captioning helps versus hurts.
Additional directions include evaluation with ViT-G/14 and domain-specific backbones (FashionCLIP), learned per-query fusion weights, and production A/B testing on live eCommerce traffic.

首先,将MLLM(WISER/SoFT)重排在CaptionFuse检索的顶部,以测试互补性——如果我们浓缩的第一阶段检索降低了重新排序器的误差率,则组合可能单以较低的总VLM成本而超过。
其次,在Titan主干线上运行嵌入空间基线(WeiMoCIR,LinCIR),以验证我们的缩放预测,即这些方法从更好的编码器获得的收益较少,因为其文本输入仍然是属性分隔.

blocks.en: Generative AI systems (Amazon Nova Pro, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, Llama 4 Maverick) were used as integral components of the proposed CaptionFuse pipeline for VLM intent captioning, as described in the experimental methodology. Additionally, AI writing assistants were used for editing and proofreading during manuscript preparation. The authors reviewed all generated outputs and take full responsibility for the content of this publication.
